title: Defining polyuria and splitting solute from water diuresis
guide: The three polyuria thresholds, the solute versus water diuresis table with its urine output, osmolality, dipstick and specific-gravity rows, and the central and nephrogenic DI cause lists including Wolfram syndrome.

title: Copeptin, the water deprivation test and central DI therapy
guide: Clinical features, the basal and arginine-stimulated copeptin cut-offs, the deprivation protocol with its stop rules, desmopressin response bands, the deprivation graph and central DI dosing.

title: Partial and nephrogenic DI, hypernatremic complication, DI versus SIADH
guide: The 3 C's for partial DI, the difficult-to-treat nephrogenic regimen with amiloride for lithium, the free-water deficit formula with 8-10 mEq/L daily limits and nasogastric topping-up, and the eight-row DI versus SIADH table including stalk-injury staging.
